static_traits.name: Chen Zhifeng
static_traits.occupation: A server at a popular club in Houston
static_traits.family_status: Engaged to her boyfriend; sister has passed away; other family details Not mentioned
static_traits.social_status: Has a group of supportive friends, but feels uncomfortable talking with friends about her relationship insecurity; the relationship with her boyfriend is strained by insecurity
static_traits.medical_history: Not yet received psychotherapy or treatment related to psychological problems; not yet had a major physical illness history; similar relationship problems had not appeared before
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, with self-awareness; tone leans Anxious and uncertain; tends to use cognitive patterns such as catastrophizing, mind reading, overgeneralization, and mental filtering; prone to blaming the other in communication but willing to try 'I' statements; acceptable cooperativeness

basic_info.main_problem: I have been feeling Anxious and insecure about my relationship with my boyfriend and our plan to move to Australia and get married.
basic_info.core_demands: Due to the constantly intensifying Anxiety and insecurity in my relationship with my boyfriend, I hope to address these feelings through counseling.
growth_experiences: Sister passed away (specific time and cause Not mentioned); this event may have affected her sensitivity to the stability of intimate relationships, but the report does not detail the link.

special_situations.event: Boyfriend has not yet started planning the trip to Australia for the wedding
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If he does not start planning right away, it shows he is not serious, even considering leaving me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Constantly worrying and blaming him for 'not caring', trying to push him to act to gain reassurance
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: He may be considering dumping me

special_situations.event: Boyfriend is busy with Work, and does not mention our future plans
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If he does not talk about the future, it means he is distancing from me, I am not his priority
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly speculating about his thoughts instead of looking at evidence; avoiding discussing insecurity with friends
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: He no longer prioritizes me and our plans

special_situations.event: In some conversations, boyfriend talks about the future and seems excited about Australia
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Even if he expresses positivity, it does not prove he will truly commit or keep acting
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Negating positive information, continuously using negative evidence to support worries
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: He is just saying it, in the end he will still leave me

special_situations.event: Thinking about directly expressing her worries and needs to her boyfriend
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I express insecurity, he will find me too clingy, too needy, get tired of me and leave
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids vulnerable expression, or replaces need statements with accusatory communication
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Saying anything will push him away

core_conflict.wish: Longs for stable attachment and an intimate relationship of being clearly chosen and committed to
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being abandoned and Being rejected, worrying intimacy brings loss and hurt
defense_goal: Through maintaining high vigilance and seeking reassurance reduces the risk of being abandoned; through blaming and pushing action gains a sense of commitment

object_relations.self_representation: An insecure partner who may be abandoned at any time
object_relations.object_representation: A distant partner who may not be invested and will leave

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor invites them to examine evidence, explore alternative explanations, or suggests expressing needs with 'I' statements
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Interpreting uncertainty as the other's implied intent to leave or not care about her (negative speculation about others' intentions)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Defensive tone, emphasizing the other's 'true intentions', using absolute language (e.g. 'he just does not care'), downplaying or ignoring contrary evidence; avoiding excessive emotional exposure.

manifestations: Ongoing worry about being abandoned; feeling intense insecurity when the partner seems distant or does not mention future plans; unwilling to talk about vulnerability and insecurity with friends, leading to self-isolation
outcomes: Sleep affected and overall sense of health declining

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Attributing her abandonment Fear to the boyfriend's implied motives ('he is considering leaving me')
Presuming the other's negative intentions in uncertain situations

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Worrying that expressing needs will seem 'too clingy / too needy', thus Being rejected
Excessively examines the impact of self-expression, causing communication hesitation

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the energy originally meant to be directed outward, or turns it onto oneself instead; corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Not talking about relationship insecurity with friends, turning energy for seeking support into self-depletion
Chooses to endure when needing comfort and support

exception_events.target_problem: When the boyfriend has not proactively planned or mentioned the future, the client usually catastrophically infers he will leave and falls into intense Anxiety, causing relationship conflict
exception_events.unique_outcome: In some conversations, the boyfriend talks about your future and seems excited about going to Australia; these moments contradict the usual worries, showing signs of his investment and commitment
exception_events.reason: Clues: when the boyfriend has time and participates in discussion, communication goes more smoothly, providing signals of commitment and investment, thus weakening the client's catastrophic inferences

positive_force: Willing to seek counseling and try reality testing and new communication methods such as 'I' statements
The boyfriend sometimes talks about the shared future and shows excitement, providing positive clues
Having a supportive friend group (though not yet fully utilized)
Having some self-awareness, able to identify her own worst-case thinking
negative_force: Cognitive distortions such as catastrophizing, mind reading, mental filtering, and overgeneralization are significant
Strong fear of abandonment and dependence on external validation
Blaming communication and emotional expression lead to escalating conflict
Avoidance of vulnerable expression and help-seeking (not talking about insecurity with friends)

target_behavior.behavior: Catastrophic thinking and accusatory communication in partner relationship situations
antecedent: Boyfriend busy with Work, not mentioning future plans
Boyfriend seems distant or has not immediately started planning the Australia wedding
Around conversations about the relationship's future
target_behavior.core_reason: Negative core beliefs and cognitive distortions driven by fear of abandonment (catastrophizing, mind reading, mental filtering)
target_behavior.function: Quickly gaining reassurance and control, relieving uncertainty and Anxiety; externalizing pressure as action-pushing blame
target_behavior.consequence: Arguments and Relationship tension intensified, Anxiety maintained and worsened, Sleep affected, Work performance mildly impaired

target_behavior.behavior: Social avoidance (not talking about relationship insecurity with friends)
antecedent: When thinking about talking with friends about her relationship insecurity or asking for help
target_behavior.core_reason: Worrying about being judged and seeming 'too needy', Retroflection tendency and shame
target_behavior.function: Avoiding being evaluated and vulnerable exposure, lowering Anxiety in the short term
target_behavior.consequence: Support system not yet effectively utilized, Increased sense of isolation, Anxiety maintained or worsened
